name: 01_ice_saw
prompt: A long hand saw cutting through thick river ice in the cold open air, slow rhythmic rasping strokes, then a deep cracking snap as a heavy slab breaks free and shifts in the water

name: 02_drain
prompt: Water trickling steadily down a stone channel and out through a small drain into the open, clean thin running stream on wet granite, close and quiet, no echo

name: 03_stone
prompt: Two heavy cut granite blocks being lowered and seated against each other, a deep gritty stone-on-stone grind settling into a solid low thud, close and dry

name: 04_draught
prompt: A low soft draught of air drawing steadily up through a narrow stone shaft, a faint hollow whistling breath rising and passing away, very quiet and airy

name: 05_straw
prompt: Handfuls of dry straw and rice husks being pushed and packed into gaps by hand, dense dry rustling and crackling, then a heavy block of ice set down onto it with a dull scrape

name: 06_summer
prompt: A quiet open summer field in the late afternoon: warm cicadas singing steadily in the distance and a soft breeze moving through dry grass, no voices, no traffic
